section.p: The Environmental Temperature (tempe) is the temperature of the motor’s surrounding area. There are two temperature sensors on both sides of the SMS: the temperature sensor on the outside side (not towards the motor) measures the environment temperature.

The recorded data shows the environmental temperature scatter plot data, in the unit of Celsius (°C). The analytics system can use this data to detect the electrical or mechanical failures of the motor.
Each record contains an array of two samples captured on the specified timestamp.
For more information on API refer to the ADI OtoSense™ SMS REST API.
